long_biography.plain_text:
Russell Stidolph began in leveraged finance at PaineWebber before moving to J.H. Whitney, where he established the private-equity firm's alternative-energy practice. He helped build Hawkeye Renewables, serving as chief financial officer and vice-chair before its sale, and worked on early wind-power investments in Iowa.

He founded AltEnergy to concentrate on energy-transition businesses and infrastructure. The firm has led investments spanning biofuels, wind generation, demand-response software, grid transmission and battery storage. Stidolph has frequently taken active roles alongside capital commitments, including board chairmanships, chief-financial-officer posts and project development. After leaving the Eos board, he shifted full-time attention to AltEnergy Acquisition Corp while retaining an Eos economic interest through AltEnergy entities.
